data.name: Althaf
data.long_meaning: Althaf is derived from the Arabic word 'thafa' which means 'to protect' or 'to shelter'. It is a name of comfort and security, evoking the image of a fortified fortress or a loving guardian. In Islamic context, it is also associated with the Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) companions who sought his protection and guidance, and were granted safety and enlightenment in return.
